name: GuidedQuestionnaire
tagline: Guided Questionnaire turns a single long-text column on a form into a step-by-step questionnaire that ends with a clear result.
description: Guided Questionnaire turns a single long-text column on a form into a step-by-step questionnaire that ends with a clear result. Visitors only see the questions that apply to them, a deciding ("knock-out") answer ends the questionnaire early with an explanation, and the answers are scored so the form can tell people straight away whether they are likely eligible, need a review or are not eligible.
features: Three layouts: one question per step (Wizard), one section per page (Sections), or all questions on one page
Start screen, progress bar, "Question 4 of 8" and a section stepper you can click back through
Single choice, multiple choice (with a limit), yes/no, number, short and long text and date questions
Questions that appear or disappear based on earlier answers; answers to hidden questions are not saved
Clear validation messages and a summary of everything that still needs an answer
A "Check your answers" page with Change links, then a coloured result banner with an explanation
Four ready-made questionnaires (presets) so you can try it with no setup
